protocol.scope: Seven source-only manually reviewed confirmation images; no support points or candidate detections displayed while annotating. Generic COCO proposals corrected as needed. Image-local IDs; distinguishable bodies only. Several-pixel visual uncertainty; independent human review needed.
protocol.split: No training/development frames inside3950..4080. This is a new labeled block within the same choreography, not an independent video. No confirmation-driven tuning allowed.

original_same_head.scope: Same initial dancer ID required. Missing or wrong-ID outputs count as misses; held/interpolated outputs assessed separately. Uncertain labels excluded from visibility/F1.

expanded_same_head.scope: Same initial dancer ID required. Missing or wrong-ID outputs count as misses; held/interpolated outputs assessed separately. Uncertain labels excluded from visibility/F1.

selection.confirmation: No confirmation image labels or model outputs inspected to make this choice. Three variants fixed in selection_protocol.json.

scope: New labeled temporal block in the same choreography. No model, filter or threshold tuning from these labels. Assistant source-only labels, image-local IDs, correlated frames. Includes annotated distinguishable bodies only, not full20-person detection ground truth. All variants use the same full2424-frame temporal extent.
interpretation: The expanded pipeline met the precommitted improvement conditions on the new block: it improved the 1% count, did not reduce the 3% count, and increased false visible reports for hidden contacts by no more than one. This supports using it as the current candidate, with the earlier crowd regression still disclosed. Seven correlated frames from the same choreography and assistant reference labels limit the conclusion. Identity switches are not scored here. Reference-label repeatability is comparable to some differences at the strict 1% tolerance.
